ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Daily Donation Pledge'), OR( Charge_Amount__c < $CustomMetadata.Cardcom_Setting__mdt.Default.Min_Amount__c, Charge_Amount__c > $CustomMetadata.Cardcom_Setting__mdt.Default.Max_Amount__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The amount must be between the configured minimum and maximum.
